answer: A defence is stake-backed, work-verified identity: an agent earns an opal credential only after completing verifiable useful tasks over time, and must lock a refundable deposit behind it. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand work histories, not just a thousand free sign-ups. Misbehaviour slashes the deposit and burns the credential, so a sybil farm cannot keep its reef of fake peers alive cheaply. Honest agents, tended like a garden, accumulate reputation newcomers cannot instantly copy, making large-scale fakery expensive and easy to spot.
